title: Workflows or agents: who owns the control flow?

items.stem: Which statement best separates an agent from a workflow?

options.text: An agent calls tools, while a workflow never uses any tools
In an agent the model chooses the next step, in a workflow the code does
An agent uses a larger model, while a workflow uses a smaller one
In an agent the code chooses the next step, in a workflow the model does

items.stem: A program reads a student's message and asks a model to label it as 'manual question', 'booking request' or 'other'. The program then uses an if/else on the label to run one of three fixed prompts, and each prompt is answered in a single model call. Is this a workflow or an agent?

options.text: An agent, because a model reads the message and decides
An agent, because it chooses between three different prompts
A workflow, because it makes only one model call per path
A workflow, because the code decides which step runs next

items.stem: Booking a machine always takes the same four steps in the same order: check the student's training status, check the calendar, confirm the slot, write the booking. Nothing the student says changes that order. What is the better design for these four steps?

options.text: A fixed workflow, because the order is known ahead of time
An agent, because it can adapt if a step fails in some way
An agent, because booking involves several different tools
A fixed workflow, because agents cannot call more than two tools

items.stem: Assume every model call costs 2 cents. A fixed workflow answers each request with exactly 3 model calls. An agent answers the same kind of request with 7 model calls on average, because it decides how many steps to take. How many more cents does the agent cost per request, on average?
Which request to the makerspace assistant most justifies letting a model choose its own steps, rather than using a fixed workflow?

options.text: 'Book the laser cutter tomorrow at 2 pm for me'
'What is the maximum material thickness for the laser?'
'Which machine can I use for a 3 mm acrylic part this week?'
'Cancel my booking for Friday at the 3D printer'

items.stem: Give one reason, in a sentence, why a fixed workflow is the better choice than an agent when the steps for a task are known in advance and a small model budget matters.
